name: Naoko Tohno
source:
Likes: Shinn, above all things
Dislikes: Men who aren't Shinn, girls who resis him

Professor Tohno is the arts teacher of Haruka Academy. She was one of Shinn's previous conquests - and perhaps the one he's most proud of. Naoko is utterly loyal towards him and will help him in his new spree of training new slaves.
